prompt: A candle starts $20$ cm tall and burns $2$ cm every hour. Write an equation for its height $h$ after $t$ hours.
hint: The height goes DOWN, so the rate is negative: $-2$ cm per hour.

hints.text: The height goes DOWN, so the rate is negative: $-2$ cm per hour.
Start at $20$, subtract $2$ for each hour: $h = 20 - \underline{\ \ }t$.

explanation: Move: the candle LOSES $2$ cm per hour, so $m = -2$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Check an hour
steps: After $3$ hours the candle burned $3 \times 2 = 6$ cm, leaving $20 - 6 = 14$ cm.

alternativeExplanations.title: Downhill stairs table
steps: Hour $0 \to 20$, hour $1 \to 18$, hour $2 \to 16$: a steady jump of $-2$.
Jump $-2$ is the slope, start $20$ is $b$: $h = -2t + 20$, the same as $20 - 2t$.
